content:
Hi everyone!

I’ve been getting into Rust for the past few months and I’d love to start contributing code to Rust for Linux. I’m still learning, so I’m looking for the easiest way in. Are there any good first issues, small tasks, or areas of the project that are beginner-friendly? Any advice on where to start (docs, tracking issues, abstractions that need help, etc.) would be much appreciated.

Thanks in advance!

Welcome! Please see https://rust-for-linux.com/contributing if you haven't seen it yet.

In addition, there are some similar topics in this Zulip from others that may help too :)
